name: @totemsdk/txpow
description: TxPoW envelope serialization, proof-of-work mining, and Machine Work Admission for the Minima protocol

scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && tsc && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('dist/cjs/package.json', JSON.stringify({type:'commonjs'})+'\n')"
scripts.postbuild: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');const src=p.join(__dirname,'src','wasm','miner.wasm');if(fs.existsSync(src)){for(const d of ['dist/wasm','dist/cjs/wasm']){const dst=p.join(__dirname,d,'miner.wasm');fs.mkdirSync(p.dirname(dst),{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(src,dst);}console.log('[@totemsdk/txpow] miner.wasm → dist/wasm/ + dist/cjs/wasm/')}else{console.log('[@totemsdk/txpow] Note: miner.wasm not compiled — JS fallback only. Run npm run build:wasm with Emscripten to enable WASM acceleration.')}"
scripts.prepare: npm run build:wasm && tsc && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('dist/cjs/package.json', JSON.stringify({type:'commonjs'})+'\n')"

author: Totem SDK
